newsitem.title: USA: Heartland Express to acquire A&M Express.
newsitem.headline: Heartland Express to acquire A&M Express.

text.p: Heartland Express Inc, a commodities transport company, said Tuesday it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire the outstanding stock of A & M Express, based in Kingsport, Tennessee.
The transaction remains subject to certain conditions, including due diligence, and is expected to close on or about July 14, Heartland Express said.

After the transaction, A & M Express, which had 1996 revenues of $28 million, will operate as a separate wholly owned subsidiary, and current owner and President Sam Easley will manage the operation, Heatland said.
